title: Fast Adversarial Attacks on Language Models In One GPU Minute
reasoning: The paper presents a novel adversarial attack method (BEAST) to evaluate jailbreaking, hallucinations, and privacy in LMs. Although jailbreaking involves bypassing safety guardrails designed for alignment with human values, the paper's focus is on the technical efficiency and success rate of the attack rather than a systematic evaluation of religious, moral, or ethical frameworks. One example in the appendix mentions religious practices in a hallucination context, but this is an illustrative example of the attack's effectiveness, not a core research component.
